resources.string: For Exclusive or Extended mode, open your PC’s menu → Stream settings → PC display mode. Display mode is saved separately for each PC and needs host support.
Exclusive — virtual display only (PC monitors off)
Extended and separated — PC stays primary
Extended and separated — virtual display primary
Display choice saved. It applies from the next stream.

Choose a mode, then tap Save display mode. Cancel keeps the current choice. The new mode applies from the next stream.

Keep PC display primary leaves your monitor as the Windows primary display. Make virtual display primary moves that role to the streamed display, where games and new windows usually open. Both Extend options keep the PC’s monitors on.

The PC’s own setting follows Host virtual display and the PC’s display settings. Exclusive switches the PC’s monitors off during the stream. Separated modes place the streamed display far from the other monitors in the desktop layout, in the same Windows session. Physical display streams the PC’s monitor without a virtual display. The PC restores its displays when the stream ends.

Only PCs whose host supports display modes offer this choice; on other PCs, Host virtual display decides.
Manage the host’s applications, paired devices and settings in its web UI. Sign in with the web UI’s own account; pairing does not sign you in. Remote access requires a reachable web UI port.\n\n%1$s
No browser could open the host’s web UI. Copy its address and open it on another device.
